name: oneday stats
description: Paired tests for subjects measured under several conditions in one acquisition: paired Wilcoxon signed-rank of each condition against a reference condition, and the Friedman test across all conditions, each Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted. Rows: the unit tested (e.g. population). Columns: subject and condition factors. Y: the value (e.g. proportion).

properties.name: reference_condition
properties.description: Condition every other condition is compared with (e.g. DMSO, BL). Required for the paired tests.

properties.name: subject_factor
properties.description: Column factor naming the subject (the pairing unit). Empty: the first column factor.

properties.name: condition_factor
properties.description: Column factor naming the condition. Empty: the second column factor.

properties.name: alpha
properties.description: Adjusted p-value below which a row is marked significant.
